On a USB DAC, the DAC\'s own volume buttons are not reflected in the app and Safety Max does not limit them.

If your DAC has its own volume (buttons or a wheel), turn it all the way up first — the worst case — and then calibrate. The app cannot read that volume, so a ceiling set with it lower stops protecting you once it is raised.
